title: Pronouns and possessive determiners
instructions: Change the **pronouns** (*I, you, me …*) and **possessive determiners** (*my, your, our …*). Think: who is speaking to whom?

items.text: Mila said that {{she}} loved {{her}} new school.
Diego said that {{they}} had lost {{their}} match.

items.direct: Tyler to Mila: "I can lend you my bike."
items.text: Tyler told Mila that {{he}} could lend {{her}} {{his}} bike.
items.hint: I → he (Tyler), you → her (Mila), my → his

items.direct: Aisha to Sofia and Mila: "I'll meet you at the mall."
items.text: Aisha told Sofia and Mila that {{she}} would meet {{them}} at the mall.
items.hint: *you* means Sofia **and** Mila here – two people.

items.direct: Mrs Moreno to Diego: "Your room is a mess."
items.text: Mrs Moreno told Diego that {{his}} room was a mess.

items.direct: Mila to Sofia: "Your brother helped me."
items.text: Mila told Sofia that {{her}} brother had helped {{her}}.

items.direct: Sofia to her parents: "Mila and I are going to bake a cake for you."
items.text: Sofia told her parents that Mila and {{she}} were going to bake a cake for {{them}}.

items.direct: Mr Okafor to Mila: "I have checked your timetable."
items.text: Mr Okafor told Mila that {{he}} had checked {{her}} timetable.
Tyler said that Diego had called {{him}} the day before.

items.direct: Aisha to you: "I like your jacket."
items.text: Aisha told me that {{she}} liked {{my}} jacket.
items.hint: Now **you** report what Aisha said to you: your → **my**.
